classified.title: Alok Kotahwala vs Jaipur Metro Rail Corporation Ltd on 13 July, 2026
classified.reason: This is a land acquisition dispute under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, concerning acquisition of land for a metro car depot. It involves no road safety issues and produces no systemic road-safety relief; it is a routine civil appeal on acquisition procedure.

classified.title: Nalini vs The Branch Manager United India ... on 17 July, 2026
classified.reason: Individual motor accident compensation appeal restoring the MACT award; no systemic road-safety relief or precedent binding on all tribunals/insurers.

classified.title: Karam Singh vs Pal Singh on 20 July, 2026
classified.reason: Individual motor accident compensation appeal; the Court merely restored the appellant's enhancement appeal to the High Court file. No systemic relief or precedent for all MACTs/insurers.

classified.title: The Oriental Insurance Co. Ltd vs Durg Roadways Private Limited on 20 July, 2026
classified.reason: Though framed as an individual insurance appeal on liability for a cross-border accident, the judgment lays down interpretive principles binding on MACTs/insurers regarding cross-border insurance coverage, applies contra proferentem, holds Section 147(5) MVA overrides IMT regulations, and issues suggestions plus directs IRDAI to consider a master circular standardising cross-border coverage clauses. This has precedential and systemic significance.

classified.title: Dilip Agarwal vs Rajshri Agarwal on 22 July, 2026
classified.reason: Individual MACT compensation appeal turning on whether death 'arose out of' use of a motor vehicle on its own facts. No systemic/nationwide directions; it applies established precedent to a specific fact situation rather than laying down a new binding rule for all tribunals.
